objects.description: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has developed malware for its operations, including malicious mobile applications and destructive malware such as [NotPetya](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0368) and [Olympic Destroyer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0365).(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) بدافزاری را برای عملیات خود ایجاد کرده است، از جمله برنامه‌های تلفن همراه مخرب و بدافزارهای مخرب مانند [NotPetya](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0368) و [Olympic Destroyer]([[P[CTI_PRESERVE_2]]][PRESERVE_3][0] (Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020) https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0365
